title: Honor Of Hearts
author: GoatKnows
selftext:
After over 10 years of working on a Trading Card Game thanks to Phaser MCP I was able to code the game with Claude Code. As a Fan of Yu-Gi-Oh I got tires of how extreme summoning rules and all that confusion so back in 2017 I started developing a Trading Card Game that would completely change the TCG & CCG genre.

HONOR OF HEARTS Beta is out please give it a try

https://honorofhearts.com/

comments.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
comments.body: why did it have to take ten years lol

replies.author: GoatKnows
replies.body: Coding & life pal trust me but thank you for the reply please try it out let me know what you think

replies.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
replies.body: All devs deal with coding and life but they're not taking 10 years to make a simple tcg

comments.author: GoatKnows
comments.body: I was working on other things as well, also the printing, & you don't know my skill level and so on. I had the physical version about prepared but other things happened, lapse in focus and so on but now due to ai Handling the coding I was able to get a fully playable Beta, we all have different situations in life going on. But again thank you for the thoughtful reply

replies.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
replies.body: None of this is a good reason to work for 10 years on the mvp of a simple tcg lol
